name: Ray Marching with Dithering and Early Termination
aliases: Raymarching with Transmittance-based Early Ray Termination
definition: Main rendering loop that marches rays through the volume, applying shading and compositing, with dithering to reduce aliasing and early termination for performance.
summary: A GPU volume rendering technique that uses dithered ray starts to reduce aliasing and transmittance-based early termination to skip opaque samples, distinguishing itself via single-pass fragment shader execution with dynamic branching.
